package.title: Aim At The Falling Monkey. Which Darts Hit?
alt_titles: Why You Should Aim Straight At A Falling Target
description: A monkey hangs 20 m away and 10 m up. The instant you fire, it lets go. Where should you aim?
Straight at it. Gravity pulls the dart and the monkey down by exactly the same ½gt², so a dart aimed at the monkey always meets it, at any speed:
12 m/s: miss. The monkey reaches the ground (1.43 s) before the dart arrives.
Exact projectile physics, no air resistance; g = 9.81 m/s². Every click is 2 m of flight.
package.question: Where would you have aimed? 👇
package.pinned: It's a classic physics demo (the 'monkey and hunter'). The minimum speed here is 15.7 m/s; slower and the monkey lands first 🐒
